reviews.comment: Never met someone make basic algebra and simple concepts more confusing than calc 3. Great guy personally but he just cant teach at all, has no consistency or structure to the lectures and just makes everything more confusing

Definitely knows what he's talking about, but sadly makes simple topics very difficult to understand. Other very positive ratings are definitely based solely on his personality which is nice and funny, however this is misleading as he really isn't a great professor. Save yourself the time and trouble and take this with someone else.

While personally supportive and willing to help, he makes every topic more confusing after explaining it while not even taking into account his accentDoesn't upload lecture slides until after you need them. If you lock in you'll pass but just know he makes the course significantly harder than it needs to be, so just take it with someone else.

Had Dr. Iakovou for IDIS 343, and could not have been happier with the class. Dr. Iakovou is extremely well respected in his field and definitely knows what he's talking about. This is not a class that you can doze off in though, his notes after class are, uhh, rough.
I had him for IDIS 343. Best professor I've had at TAMU. Highly recommend you take his course. You will have to think and apply yourself, but he makes the course very engaging.

You can tell he is a very kind guy that wants his students to do well, but his methods are just not very good. Lectures and practice problems dont get posted to canvass, and it is very difficult to find outside information to help teach you the course. This is important, as his accent is extremely difficult to understand.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wildly intelligent, super nice guy who genuinely wants you to do well in his class. Iakovou is a leader in his field and explains it at a level you can understand, which means he truly knows what he's doing. Very down to earth guy and has great pieces of wisdom for life, and I will be keeping in touch with him. TAKE HIS CLASSES IF YOURE ID AT A&M

One of the most engaging professors I have ever met. Each class is filled with energy from Dr. Iakovou. I look forward to coming to his class even though some of the material is difficult to understand. His PhD will go over your head but he is genuine and cares about his students understanding SCM and SM. His Greek accent is awesome.
